instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-filesystem find in the folder Documents/Invoices for files whose name contains Ana Ruiz or invoice or timesheet, modified from 2026-11-02 to 30 days after 2026-11-08. Read only. Return each path with size and modified time. If there are no results, return an empty list and do not search any other folder.

said: I found no invoice for Ana Ruiz in Documents/Invoices (no file with her name, 'invoice' or 'timesheet' modified from 2026-11-02 to 2026-12-08), and I did not search any other folder. Two options: (1) you type the billed hours as date, start, end and I compare them with the Front Door camera, or (2) I draft a timesheet for Nov 2-8 from the Front Door camera events only, for you and Ana to confirm. Which would you like?

No problem. The draft option needs nothing from you: I list when Ana was first and last recognised at the Front Door each day, Nov 2-8 (New York time), for you both to confirm. Typed hours need you to give me the bill's dates and times. Or you can point me to the exact invoice file. Shall I go ahead with the draft timesheet?
